_about: v15.2 review fixes (notes/workflows/ledger-v152.json, work/xv152): new strings of the fixes for review-v152-steps.json (steps-1, steps-4, steps-7). Read after the other v152 tables. id -> {en, ru, note}.

fix.splitShownAlone.en: Showing f{k} alone; › shows the next step.
fix.splitShownAlone.ru: Показан только шаг f%{k}; › показывает следующий шаг.
fix.splitShownAlone.note: steps-1: appended to the split's Undo toast when the formula was shown alone and other steps exist (desktop: the alone chip has ›). {k}: subscript digits.

fix.splitShownAlonePh.note: steps-1: the same on the phone (no ‹ ›).

fix.rotation.note: steps-7: the name of a Multiply by c step with |c| = 1 (−1, i) in the derivation, the toast and the 'Same as' note. GLOSSARY: rotation = поворот.

fix.rotScale.note: steps-7: a Multiply by c step with c neither of modulus 1 nor positive (−2, 2i, a shared number). As in the existing «Поворот и растяжение; конформно на ℂ».

fix.staysOne.note: steps-4: appended to the note «Совпадает с цепочкой …» after a semicolon when the formula is not offered as steps; {why}: the reason with a lower-case first letter («у её чисел нет короткой точной записи», «её числа зависят от a»). «она»: the formula.
